cases.scope: Source-shaped active-count branch characterization, not a runtime repair. One producer and helper, at most two spurious wakes, coherent count protected by one mutex. Separate decrement, wait registration, wake, reacquisition and count recheck. Producer termination may occur after wake but before helper reacquires. Controls omit nonzero restoration or restore after zero termination; neither is attributed to current source. Producer lock/count/signal/unlock is folded because it publishes no further work. Excludes graphs, real queue locks, multiple producers, condition errors, unbounded wakes, C weak memory and native acceptance.
